paragraphs: Rabbi Acha bar Bivi: Yevamot 40a, as cited in the supplied text.
Rabbi Yose bar Bivi: Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim, chapter 3, halakhah 2.

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Pesachim 110a fully writes Rav Chananya bar Bivi, supporting Rav in the second notice. The first notice’s Acha bar Bivi citation was not located in the saved full digital folios Yevamot 40a or 40b; the supplied 40a locator and name are retained as an open question, without a work-wide absence claim.

Hyman’s index (vol. I, p. 264) prints Rav Acha bar Bivi with the same 40a citation. His separate entries on pp. 125 and 266 cite Yevamot 8a for Rav Acha bar Bivi Mar. The passage there names him speaking to Ravina in Rava’s name and continues onto 8b. In Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:2, the consulted text reads Rabbi Yose bar Bevin, transmitting in the name of Rabbi Yochanan and, later, in the name of Shmuel. The index groups these notices by name form.
